newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai sees 13 mln 'virtual pet' sales by Mar 1998.
newsitem.headline: Bandai sees 13 mln 'virtual pet' sales by Mar 1998.

text.p: Bandai Co Ltd said on Tuesday it aims to sell a cumulative total of 13 million units of its "tamagotchi" virtual pet toy by the end of March 1998.
"We plan to sell 13 million units by the end of next March. The product has become popular much more quickly than we had expected," a spokeswoman said.

She also said there was a delay in the launch in the U.S. market of the "Pippin Atmark", an Internet and multimedia appliance made under licence from Apple Computer Inc, but did did not give a reason or say when sales would start there. They had been due to begin in March.
Apple said in March it would stop making Apple-brand Pippins as part of a restructuring.
The Bandai spokeswoman said the company had sold a total of 30,000 units of the Pippin in Japan since its launch in March 1996. It had initially planned to sell 200,000 units in the first year.
